text.setup: Take the bar from the rack onto your upper back. Step one foot forward and the other back into a long split stance, back heel raised.
cues: Drop the back knee straight down towards the floor.
Keep most of your weight on the front foot.
Stand up without moving your feet.
mistakes: Stance too narrow, like walking on a tightrope.
text.safety: Use a rack with safety pins and finish all reps on one side before switching.

text.setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and take a long step into a split stance, back heel up.
cues: Lower the back knee until it nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front heel to rise.
mistakes: Leaning far forward over the front knee.

text.setup: Stand about two foot-lengths in front of a bench, holding dumbbells at your sides. Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
cues: Sink straight down until the front thigh is about parallel.
Keep the front knee tracking over the toes.
Drive up through the front foot.
mistakes: Standing too close to the bench.

text.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, feet hip-width apart.
cues: Step one foot back and lower the back knee towards the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
mistakes: Stepping back in a straight line so balance is lost.

text.setup: Hold dumbbells at your sides with a clear walkway of about 10 metres in front of you.
cues: Take a long step and lower the back knee towards the floor.
Drive up and bring the back foot through into the next step.
mistakes: Short choppy steps that overload the front knee.

text.setup: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench at about knee height, a dumbbell in each hand. Place one whole foot on the box.
cues: Lean slightly forward and stand up using the top leg.
Lower slowly with the same leg in control.
mistakes: Pushing off the bottom foot to bounce up.

text.setup: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest and stand with feet hip-width apart.
cues: Step back and drop the back knee under control.
Keep the bell close and the chest tall.
mistakes: Letting the bell pull the torso forward.

text.setup: Attach a handle to the lowest pulley and hold it at your chest with both hands. Step back into a split stance facing the machine.
cues: Lower the back knee straight down.
Keep the handle at your chest throughout.
mistakes: Letting the cable pull you forward off balance.

text.setup: Set the bar at shoulder height and the stops just above your lowest position. Get under the bar and step into a split stance with the front foot slightly ahead of the bar.
cues: Unhook the bar and sink the back knee down.
Drive up through the front foot.
mistakes: Front foot directly under the bar so the knee travels far forward.

text.setup: Step into a long split stance with hands on hips or holding a support.
cues: Lower straight down until the back knee almost touches the floor.
Rise by pushing through the front heel.
mistakes: Letting the front knee cave inwards.

text.setup: Stand in front of a bench with the top of your back foot resting on it.
cues: Drop straight down under control.
Keep your torso tall and drive up through the front foot.

text.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
cues: Step back and lower the back knee gently.
Return to standing through the front foot.
mistakes: Slamming the back knee into the floor.

text.setup: Face a sturdy step, box or bench at a height where your thigh is roughly level when your foot is on top.
cues: Step up and stand fully on the top leg.
Step down slowly with the same leg leading back.
mistakes: Using momentum from the bottom foot.

text.setup: Stand with feet together, then take a wide step out to the side.
cues: Sit back into the stepping leg while the other leg stays straight.
Push back to the start.
mistakes: Letting the bent knee collapse inwards.
